title: Even-Odd Tree Validation
problemStatement: Given a binary tree, determine whether it satisfies the Even-Odd Tree property. Nodes at even-indexed levels must contain strictly increasing odd values, while nodes at odd-indexed levels must contain strictly decreasing even values.
input: • The first line contains an integer N. • The second line contains the node values. • The next N lines describe the binary tree.
output: • Print YES if the tree satisfies the property; otherwise print NO.
